title: Sales Tax — changing State keeps the previous City and sends the old County/City ids
requirementSource: NM-4021 §12 TC-ST-12 — changing State after County/City are chosen resets both and reloads County for the new State
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Tax → Sales Tax for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/taxes/sales-tax) on e2e as the automation user.
Choose State AK, County MATANUSKA-SUSITNA, City WASILLA.
Click Search and inspect the search request.
expectedBehavior: County and City return to All; the search sends stateId=49 (CA) only.
actualBehavior: County shows blank and City still shows WASILLA. The search sends stateId=49 (CA) with countyId=1962 (MATANUSKA-SUSITNA, AK) and cityId=23984 (WASILLA, AK) and returns 0 records.

verificationLog.finding: Reproduced live on e2e (office 1101) during NM-4021 automation; the affected test asserts the documented behaviour under test.fail.
Also reproduced on the Sales Tax History tab (TC-TAX-ST-057).
